description: This Java class defines the entity 'ProductReviewDescription', representing the localized description of a product review in an e-commerce system. It extends a base 'Description' class, includes annotations for persistence mapping, and manages a many-to-one relationship to 'ProductReview'.

classes.name: ProductReviewDescription
classes.description: Entity class for localized product review descriptions, extending Description and linked to the ProductReview entity.
